The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends the development of a structured hypoglycemia prevention plan. This plan should include a thorough evaluation of the patient’s medical history, assessment of cognitive function, re-evaluation of current treatment regimens, and the prescription of glucagon when clinically indicated. Table 6.7 outlines the critical components of this prevention plan. These include regular assessments of the patient’s history of hypoglycemia, evaluation of their hypoglycemia awareness, structured educational interventions for the patient, and consideration of the need for continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Particular emphasis is placed on educating patients about hypoglycemia awareness, especially for individuals who have impaired hypoglycemia awareness or experience recurrent episodes of hypoglycemia.
